'''''Rediscovering the Jedi''''' was a work published by a famed [[Historian/Legends|historian]], [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Bleys Harand]], during the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It focused on information about the nearly extinct [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. However, as any mention of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was outlawed in the Empire, Harand's work was quickly banned.<ref name="Force and Destiny Core Rulebook" />
